title: How C becomes a program: cheat sheet

blocks.title: The big idea
blocks.body: Building a C program is four stages: preprocess, compile, assemble, link. Each stage has its own job and its own kind of error. Knowing which stage failed tells you where to look.

blocks.title: The four stages
items: Compile: C becomes assembly, grammar and types are checked
Assemble: assembly becomes machine code in a `.o` file
Link: object files and libraries become one program

blocks.body: Fix the first error first, and wrap macro parameters in parentheses.
